Body.Content:
What and why

We’re expanding Facilitator support in Microsoft Teams channel meetings. Users will be able to add Facilitator to channel meetings to take notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and manage tasks.

This message is associated with Microsoft 365 Roadmap ID 568936.

Rollout schedule

  • Targeted Release: Beginning in mid-September 2026 and expected to complete by late September 2026
  • General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in late September 2026 and expected to complete by mid-October 2026

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • Organizations that have enabled Facilitator in Microsoft Teams
  • Users licensed for Facilitator

Platforms and services

  • Microsoft Teams
  • Teams channel meetings

What will happen

  • Users will be able to add Facilitator to channel meetings.
  • Facilitator can take notes, manage the agenda, answer questions, and manage tasks.

Action required and recommendations

No action is required to prepare for this update.

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.

message.Title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator can join channel meetings
